description: This file defines the 'FormResource' class, an entity used within the OpenMRS healthcare system to represent key-value pairs attached to forms. It includes annotations for ORM mapping, caching, auditing, and custom datatype handling. The class provides methods for managing form resources, their data types, referencing, and change tracking.

classes.name: FormResource
classes.description: Represents a customizable resource linked to a form, allowing modules to attach arbitrary key-value information with data type descriptors and change tracking.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the form resource ID, used as the unique identifier.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the form resource ID.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Retrieves the associated form object.

methods.name: setForm
methods.description: Associates a form with this resource.

methods.name: getFormResourceId
methods.description: Retrieves the primary key ID of the resource.

methods.name: setFormResourceId
methods.description: Sets the primary key ID for the resource.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the resource.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the resource.

methods.name: getDatatypeClassname
methods.description: Gets the class name string indicating the data type of the value.

methods.name: setDatatypeClassname
methods.description: Sets the class name string indicating the data type of the value.

methods.name: getDatatypeConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the JSON configuration for the data type.

methods.name: setDatatypeConfig
methods.description: Sets the JSON configuration for the data type.

methods.name: getPreferredHandlerClassname
methods.description: Gets the class name string of the preferred handler.

methods.name: setPreferredHandlerClassname
methods.description: Sets the class name string of the preferred handler.

methods.name: getHandlerConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for the handler.

methods.name: setHandlerConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration for the handler.

methods.name: getDescriptor
methods.description: Returns the current FormResource object, fulfilling interface requirements.

methods.name: getValueReference
methods.description: Gets the reference string to the stored value, throws if not yet persisted.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the typed value, converting from reference string if necessary.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the typed value and marks the object as dirty.

methods.name: setValueReferenceInternal
methods.description: Sets the internal string reference to the value for persistence.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Deprecated method to check if the object has unsaved changes.

methods.name: getDirty
methods.description: Checks if the object is marked as dirty.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Returns the user who last changed the resource.

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who last modified the resource.

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the resource was last changed.

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the date when the resource was last modified.
